Comment.value: Shard of Fate (Loot Overhaul Phase 7, roadmap lo-fate-token). Inert token found by tag (Tag == ResRef). Two uses: anvil reply 'Reforge its fate' (forge_fate_can / forge_fate_go -> loot_inc Loot_Reforge) and the boss bonus-roll prompt (loot_ondeath -> fate_open / fate_evt). Sources: ~10% boss drop (loot/tokens.json fate.boss_chance), merit shop reward 305, Loot Lab. Plot = never sold to a store; tradeable. Gate: loot_model.validate_tokens.

value.0:
A splinter of pale crystal that will not stay still in the hand. Light moves inside it like water, and those who stare too long swear they glimpse the same moment play out a dozen different ways. The loremasters call it a Shard of Fate: a fragment of what might have been, broken loose when a great power fell.

It has two uses, and either one spends it.

Reforge its fate. Lay a piece of rolled loot on the anvil of a Forge of Wonders smith, keep the Shard in your pack, and ask the smith to reforge its fate. The item's random enchantments are unmade and drawn anew, at the same loot level and rarity. Enchantments you forged onto it yourself, and gems set in its sockets, are left alone.

A bonus roll on a boss. When a boss you helped to fight falls, the Shard stirs and offers you a personal roll on that boss's hoard. Accept, and one item from it goes straight into your pack. You may do this once per boss per day.

A Shard can be traded or given away, but no merchant will buy one.
A splinter of pale, restless crystal. Light moves inside it like water.
